name: Hörmann Cover
description: The `hoermann_hcp` component allows you to control Hörmann garage door motors through the HCP bus built into the motor. It emulates the Hörmann UAP1 module, so the motor's bus controller communicates with ESPHome just like it would with Hörmann's own accessory.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The Modbus server address the component answers on. Defaults to `2`, which is the address the motor's bus controller expects the UAP1 module on. You should not need to change this.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval at which the connection to the bus controller is checked and state changes are published. Raising it delays every door state update by the same amount. Defaults to `500ms`.

config_entries.label: Modbus ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [Modbus](https://esphome.io/components/modbus/) hub.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
